description: Field names and blocking rules for motion/facial/voice capture consent. Data only; adapt to the jurisdiction your legal team approved.

scopes.facial-mocap: Facial capture, blendshape solving and likeness use
scopes.voice: Voice recording, lip-sync analysis and synthetic speech

rules: Model training is a separate opt-in (training_permitted); absence of a flag means not permitted.
Territory 'none' blocks release; territory must name countries or 'worldwide'.
Expired consent (expires before today) blocks any new output.
Retention policy must state the destruction date or review cadence for raw capture data.
Store signed consent forms beside the capture in 00-admin, never only in email.
